questions.background: Bharuch district is known for its industrial belt, particularly in chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Industrial safety incidents, though unfortunate, highlight the need for stringent adherence to safety protocols in such high-risk environments.
questions.examRelevance: A chemical unit blast occurred in Bharuch, Gujarat, killing five workers.

source.title: Five workers killed, many injured in blast at chemical unit in Gujarat’s Bharuch

questions.question: When is World Mental Health Day observed annually?
questions.explanation: World Mental Health Day is observed annually on October 10. The day aims to raise awareness about mental health issues around the world and to mobilise efforts in support of mental health.
questions.background: Institutions in Tamil Nadu are highlighted for continuing mental health awareness initiatives throughout the year, beyond this specific day, emphasizing sustained efforts.
questions.examRelevance: World Mental Health Day is on October 10.

questions.question: By what percentage have India's fuel exports to Western countries recently increased, according to reports?
questions.explanation: India’s fuel exports to Western countries have recently jumped by 43%, as Indian refiners continue to process Russian crude oil.
questions.background: This surge highlights India's role in global energy markets and its strategy of leveraging discounted Russian crude amidst international sanctions.

questions.question: Which Category 3 hurricane, the first major hurricane of an unusually quiet Atlantic season, recently lashed the U.S. Gulf Coast?
questions.explanation: Hurricane Isaias, a Category 3 storm, recently lashed the U.S. Gulf Coast with wind and rain. It is notable for being the first major hurricane of what has been an unusually quiet Atlantic season, and it was expected to make landfall on Friday night.
questions.background: Hurricanes are tropical cyclones that form over the Atlantic Ocean or eastern North Pacific Ocean. They are categorized based on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale, with Category 3 indicating sustained winds of 111-129 mph (178-208 km/h).
questions.examRelevance: Hurricane Isaias is the first major hurricane of the Atlantic season to lash the U.S. Gulf Coast.

source.title: Hurricane Isaias lashes U.S. Gulf Coast with wind and rain hours before it comes ashore

questions.question: Tyagi Sankaralinganar, to whom Tamil Nadu CM Vijay paid homage, sacrificed his life after a 76-day hunger strike primarily demanding what?
options: Inclusion of Tamil in the Eighth Schedule
Renaming the state as Tamil Nadu
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay paid homage to Tyagi Sankaralinganar on his death anniversary. Sankaralinganar sacrificed his life after observing a 76-day hunger strike, with his principal demand being the renaming of the state as Tamil Nadu.
questions.background: Sankaralinganar's hunger strike in 1956 was a pivotal moment in the movement for renaming Madras State to Tamil Nadu, a demand that was eventually met in 1969. His sacrifice is remembered as a significant event in Tamil Nadu's political history.
questions.examRelevance: Tyagi Sankaralinganar demanded renaming the state as Tamil Nadu.

source.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay pays homage to Tyagi Sankaralinganar on his death anniversary

questions.explanation: Keralam's Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau (VACB) recently registered two FIRs in the CMRL pay-off case. Among the accused are Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, his daughter Veena, and son-in-law Mohamed Riyas.

questions.question: Which country recently prolonged its Schengen suspension with Spain, aligning with a similar countermeasure taken by Madrid?

questions.question: What phenomenon in frogs, which is becoming more frequent due to global warming, is now identified as an extinction risk?
questions.explanation: Global warming is making sex reversal in frogs more frequent, which is now identified as an extinction risk. In a population skewed towards one sex due to these changes, individuals may run out of mates to reproduce with, threatening their survival.
questions.background: Sex reversal, where an individual changes its sex during its lifetime, is a documented phenomenon in the animal kingdom. However, the increased frequency due to a warming planet disrupts population demographics and reproductive success, posing a serious threat to amphibian species already vulnerable to environmental changes.
questions.examRelevance: Global warming is turning frogs’ sex reversal into an extinction risk.

source.title: Global warming is turning frogs’ sex reversal into an extinction risk

questions.question: Who among the following Indian business leaders is set to receive France’s highest civilian honour?

questions.background: France's highest civilian award is the Legion of Honour (Légion d'honneur), established by Napoleon Bonaparte. It is bestowed upon individuals for their outstanding services to France, regardless of their nationality.
questions.examRelevance: Sunil Bharti Mittal to receive France’s highest civilian honour.

source.title: Sunil Bharti Mittal to receive France’s top honour
